d: Long, wavy lavender-grey hair with blunt bangs and two low side-tails is topped by a white sailor cap with a red bow. The eyes are a matching shade of lavender-grey with a calm, neutral expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The slender build is dressed in a white and red-striped sailor-inspired outfit featuring oversized white bell sleeves, a red-and-white pleated mini-skirt, a red tie, white stockings, and brown loafers. A black belt with gold buckles and star accents cinches the waist, while the right hand holds a small, blue-and-white stylized mechanical creature.
